title: Letter grade as a char
hints: Check the highest grade first. As soon as one check matches, `return` that letter; the rest of the function is skipped.
Use a chain: `if (score >= 90) ... else if (score >= 80) ...` and so on, with a final `else` for `'F'`. Remember: a `char` goes in **single** quotes.
`if (score >= 90) return 'A'; else if (score >= 80) return 'B'; else if (score >= 70) return 'C'; else if (score >= 60) return 'D'; else return 'F';`
